$comment: Models scripts/scribe-ollama.js offers for Scribe, best first. Each is checked live against Ollama's registry before it is shown (a tag that is gone is skipped) and sized from its manifest. Picked for following instructions and answering in JSON quickly; coding-only and embedding models are left out. The newest tool-capable models on ollama.com are listed live beside these.

models.name: qwen3.8:27b

models.name: qwen3.6:35b-a3b
models.note: Mixture of experts: only 3B active, so quick for its size with lots of memory
